summary: I am currently a Jarvis consultant who graduated from Ontario Tech University with a Computer Science Co-op Bachelors of Science. During my co-op I worked at Code Ninjas as a black box tester for an in-house web tool with a small team of developers, as well a Computer Science Educator for children aged 5-15. What drew me into data engineering is my love for solving puzzles. Planning and building data pipelines, turning noisy data into clean predictable data, feels like a big puzzle and is very satisfying when everything comes together.
